value.rationale: At fixed spectral magnitudes the L6 phase response is a natural Fourier stability/robustness quantity. Its sharp universal dynamic range and unique non-unimodular extremizing magnitude ratio are complete, motivated invariants; neither is determined by the known sharp Nikolskii norm constant. The answer is a nontrivial algebraic optimization over all analytic quadratic coefficient magnitudes rather than a routine substitution or single-case computation.
